tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The canvas. The ground the whole application sits on, the colour of unbleached paper.

tokens.name: surfaceDim
tokens.usage: The darkest light ground. A dimmed well behind a quiet block. onSecondaryContainer is not approved on it.

tokens.name: surfaceBright
tokens.usage: A light ground with the value of surface. Use it where a component asks for the bright ground.

tokens.name: surfaceContainerLowest
tokens.usage: The card. Panels, the focused entry card, a floating sheet and the halo around the ring bead.

tokens.name: surfaceContainerLow
tokens.usage: A step between a card and the canvas.

tokens.name: surfaceContainer
tokens.usage: The recessed surface. Inset metrics, inactive day wells, a resting chip and a recessed card.

tokens.name: surfaceContainerHigh
tokens.usage: The selected well. Selected dates, active toggle chips and the pressed state of a secondary control.

tokens.name: surfaceContainerHighest
tokens.usage: The highest container step. A light ground for text.

tokens.name: onSurface
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 12.19 to 1 on surfaceDim and 17.09 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. Headings and interface words alike. It is never pure black.

tokens.name: onSurfaceVariant
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 6.68 to 1 on surfaceDim and 9.37 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. Secondary text: metadata, footnotes and supporting lines.

tokens.name: inverseSurface
tokens.usage: A dark ground for an inverse block. Only inverseOnSurface and inversePrimary carry text on it.

tokens.name: inverseOnSurface
tokens.usage: Text on inverseSurface only, at 11.66 to 1.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: A line, never a word. It measures 3.20 to 1 on surfaceDim and 4.48 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest, so it clears 3 to 1 for a mark but misses 4.5 to 1 for text.

tokens.name: outlineVariant
tokens.usage: The hairline. A one point border on a card, a field and a chip. It measures 1.70 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest and 1.62 to 1 on surface. This is below 3 to 1 for a control border. The source keeps it on purpose, because a surface step carries the structure. Flagged.

tokens.name: surfaceTint
tokens.usage: A tint of the brand colour for a fill. onPrimary carries text on it at 6.47 to 1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ember, the brand colour. The pressed state of a primary action, and the ink of the wordmark and the ring mark. onPrimary on it measures 8.63 to 1.

tokens.name: onPrimary
tokens.usage: Text on primary (8.63 to 1), primaryContainer (5.96 to 1) and surfaceTint (6.47 to 1). The words of a primary button.

tokens.name: primaryContainer
tokens.usage: The primary action. The ground of a primary button, a primary chip, the ring bead, a selected chip border, the checked mark and the focus ring. It measures 4.26 to 1 on surfaceDim and 5.96 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest as a mark.

tokens.name: onPrimaryContainer
tokens.usage: Text on primaryContainer (4.53 to 1) and primary (6.56 to 1).

tokens.name: inversePrimary
tokens.usage: An accent word on inverseSurface only, at 7.77 to 1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 4.59 to 1 on surfaceDim and 6.44 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. Also a ground for onSecondary.

tokens.name: onSecondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary only, at 6.44 to 1.

tokens.name: secondaryContainer
tokens.usage: A quiet neutral fill behind onSecondaryContainer.

tokens.name: onSecondaryContainer
tokens.usage: Text on secondaryContainer (4.53 to 1) and on nine light grounds. It measures 4.19 to 1 on surfaceDim, which fails 4.5 to 1, so the source does not approve it there. Flagged.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 6.17 to 1 on surfaceDim and 8.65 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. Also a ground for onTertiary.

tokens.name: onTertiary
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary (8.65 to 1) and tertiaryContainer (5.97 to 1).

tokens.name: tertiaryContainer
tokens.usage: A deep red fill behind onTertiary or onTertiaryContainer.

tokens.name: onTertiaryContainer
tokens.usage: Text on tertiaryContainer only, at 4.55 to 1.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 4.61 to 1 on surfaceDim and 6.46 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. The alert colour, and the ground for onError.

tokens.name: onError
tokens.usage: Text on error only, at 6.46 to 1.

tokens.name: errorContainer
tokens.usage: The ground behind a longer alert message.

tokens.name: onErrorContainer
tokens.usage: Text on errorContainer (7.24 to 1) and on the ten light grounds, from 6.67 to 1.

tokens.name: primaryFixed
tokens.usage: A light fixed tint of the brand colour for a fill.

tokens.name: primaryFixedDim
tokens.usage: A deeper fixed tint of the brand colour for a fill.

tokens.name: onPrimaryFixed
tokens.usage: Text on primaryFixed (13.33 to 1), primaryFixedDim (10.11 to 1) and the ten light grounds.

tokens.name: onPrimaryFixedVariant
tokens.usage: Text on primaryFixed (7.28 to 1), primaryFixedDim (5.52 to 1) and the ten light grounds.

tokens.name: secondaryFixed
tokens.usage: A fixed neutral fill.

tokens.name: secondaryFixedDim
tokens.usage: A deeper fixed neutral fill.

tokens.name: onSecondaryFixed
tokens.usage: Text on secondaryFixed, secondaryFixedDim (10.04 to 1) and the ten light grounds.

tokens.name: onSecondaryFixedVariant
tokens.usage: Text on secondaryFixed, secondaryFixedDim (5.48 to 1) and the ten light grounds.

tokens.name: tertiaryFixed
tokens.usage: A light fixed red tint for a fill.

tokens.name: tertiaryFixedDim
tokens.usage: A deeper fixed red tint for a fill.

tokens.name: onTertiaryFixed
tokens.usage: Text on tertiaryFixed, tertiaryFixedDim (10.04 to 1) and the ten light grounds.

tokens.name: onTertiaryFixedVariant
tokens.usage: Text on tertiaryFixed (7.24 to 1), tertiaryFixedDim (5.50 to 1) and the ten light grounds.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: A light ground with the value of surface.

tokens.name: onBackground
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 12.19 to 1 on surfaceDim and 17.09 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest.

tokens.name: surfaceVariant
tokens.usage: A light ground with the value of surfaceContainerHighest.

tokens.name: period
tokens.usage: The Period arc of the ring and the Period shapes of the illustration. A fill never carries text of any size. As a mark it measures 2.81 to 1 on surface, below 3 to 1. The gap of ground at each boundary and the phase name in words carry the meaning, so colour is never the only cue. Flagged.

tokens.name: periodInk
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 8.95 to 1 on surfaceDim and 12.54 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. The words about the Period phase, on a light ground. On its own fill it measures 4.24 to 1, which fails, so it is never used there. Flagged.

tokens.name: follicular
tokens.usage: The Follicular arc of the ring and the Follicular shapes of the illustration. A fill never carries text of any size. As a mark it measures 1.96 to 1 on surface, below 3 to 1. The gap of ground at each boundary and the phase name in words carry the meaning, so colour is never the only cue. Flagged.

tokens.name: follicularInk
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 7.11 to 1 on surfaceDim and 9.96 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. The words about the Follicular phase, on a light ground. On its own fill it measures 4.85 to 1. The rule keeps it off the fill all the same.

tokens.name: ovulation
tokens.usage: The Ovulation arc of the ring and the Ovulation shapes of the illustration. A fill never carries text of any size. As a mark it measures 2.41 to 1 on surface, below 3 to 1. The gap of ground at each boundary and the phase name in words carry the meaning, so colour is never the only cue. Flagged.

tokens.name: ovulationInk
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 7.45 to 1 on surfaceDim and 10.45 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. The words about the Ovulation phase, on a light ground. On its own fill it measures 4.13 to 1, which fails, so it is never used there. Flagged.

tokens.name: luteal
tokens.usage: The Luteal arc of the ring and the Luteal shapes of the illustration. A fill never carries text of any size. As a mark it measures 3.23 to 1 on surface.

tokens.name: lutealInk
tokens.usage: Text on the ten light grounds. It measures 8.40 to 1 on surfaceDim and 11.78 to 1 on surfaceContainerLowest. The words about the Luteal phase, on a light ground. On its own fill it measures 3.47 to 1, which fails, so it is never used there. Flagged.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The one hero statement on a screen. No screen draws it today. Proposed: 44 over 56, ratio 1.273, cap 29.5. Was 48 over 56, ratio 1.167, below the 1.2 floor.

styles.name: display-lg-mobile
styles.usage: The first run hero and the lock screen title. Unchanged at 36 over 44, cap 24.1. The export writes this role into its own style sheet.

styles.name: headline-lg
styles.sample: Emi learns your cycle. You keep your data.
styles.usage: A screen title, and the wordmark on the home screen. Proposed: 28 over 36, cap 18.8. Was 32 over 40.

styles.name: headline-md
styles.sample: Between the 19th and the 21st of July
styles.usage: A section heading and the forecast range. Proposed: 20 over 26, cap 13.4. Was 24 over 32.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: A small heading, and the prompt above a journal field. Proposed: 18 over 24, cap 12.1. Was 20 over 28.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Your cycle is worked out on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
styles.usage: Running text. It carries 42 call sites, more than any other role. Proposed: 16 over 24, ratio 1.5, cap 11.9. Was 18 over 28. It also takes the call sites of body-md, which goes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: High confidence, from your last 6 cycles
styles.usage: A secondary line: confidence, metadata, a hint. Unchanged at 14 over 20.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Button words and control labels. Unchanged at 14 over 20. It shares its size with body-sm and differs by weight and tracking.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: The phase name inside the ring, set in capitals, and other small labels. Unchanged at 12 over 16.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The cycle day at the centre of the ring. Proposed: 24 over 30, cap 17.5. Was 28 over 36. It stays under headline-lg.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: A small figure: a day count, a date in a grid, a duration. Unchanged at 12 over 16.

spacing.note: Points on a phone. One rem of the document is 16 points. Proposed scale: eight steps. The steps gutter, gutterMd and gutterLg go, because each repeats the value of another step and no screen draws them.

tokens.name: spaceXs
tokens.usage: The smallest gap: an icon and its label, two lines of one block. Unchanged.

tokens.name: spaceSm
tokens.usage: A gap inside a group, the vertical padding of a chip, and the gap between two cards in a row. Unchanged.

tokens.name: spaceMd
tokens.usage: The padding inside a field, the horizontal padding of a chip, and a gap between items of one block. Unchanged.

tokens.name: spaceLg
tokens.usage: The padding inside a card, and the largest gap between two blocks of one section. Unchanged.

tokens.name: spaceXl
tokens.usage: The gap between one section and the next section. Never between a sentence and its button. Proposed: 32. Was 40.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: The horizontal padding of every screen, and the padding of the dock through the px-margin class. Proposed: 24. Was 16.

tokens.name: marginMd
tokens.usage: The screen margin at the tablet breakpoint, which version 1 does not draw. Unchanged.

tokens.name: marginLg
tokens.usage: The margin that holds a browser page to a reading width, which the brand pages draw. Unchanged.

tokens.name: rounded-sm
tokens.usage: The code key sm. A checkbox, and the smallest box on a screen.

tokens.name: rounded-DEFAULT
tokens.usage: The code key DEFAULT. A small box.

tokens.name: rounded-md
tokens.usage: The code key md. The corner the code draws most, on 20 call sites. The document names no role for it. See the open decisions.

tokens.name: rounded-lg
tokens.usage: The code key lg. Buttons, fields and chips, as the document says. The code draws it on 12 call sites.

tokens.name: rounded-xl
tokens.usage: The code key xl. Cards and containers, as the document says.

tokens.name: rounded-full
tokens.usage: The code key full. A capsule, and any circular node. It is larger than any box Emi draws.

tokens.name: icon-corner
tokens.usage: The corner of a rectangle inside an icon, on the 24 unit icon grid. The code name is ICON_CORNER.

shadow.note: The one shadow. The document prose defines it. The front matter does not name it.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Layer 2 only: a floating sheet on surfaceContainerLowest with an outlineVariant hairline. It is onSurface at 5 per cent, 4 points down, blurred 20 points, drawn 2 points inside the edge. Cards take no shadow.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: A rule, and the one point border of a card, a field and a chip. The code name is stroke.hairline.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: The one stroke of every icon in the set. The code name is stroke.icon.

size.note: Fixed sizes in points from the tokens package.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: The smallest touch box on both axes. A smaller control still takes a touch anywhere inside this box. The code name is MINIMUM_TAP_TARGET.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: The grid every icon is drawn on. The code name is ICON_SIZE.

tokens.name: ring-diameter
tokens.usage: How wide the cycle ring is drawn, on the phone and in the brand picture. The code name is RING_DIAMETER.

tokens.name: ring-track
tokens.usage: The thickness of the ring track. The code name is RING_TRACK_WIDTH.

tokens.name: bead-radius
tokens.usage: The radius of the filled bead that marks today on the ring, in primaryContainer. The code name is BEAD_RADIUS.

tokens.name: bead-halo
tokens.usage: The ground drawn around the bead in surfaceContainerLowest, so it reads on any phase. The code name is BEAD_HALO_WIDTH.

tokens.name: ring-gap
tokens.usage: The ground between two arcs of the ring. It carries each phase boundary for a person who cannot tell the fills apart. The code name is GAP_DEGREES.

tokens.name: days-ahead
tokens.usage: The strength of the ring for days she has not reached yet. Days she has reached draw at full strength. The code name is DAYS_AHEAD_STRENGTH.
